why: Shell cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-1.md, P2 shell-1.10 to shell-1.13, P3 shell-1.15 to shell-1.18): the shell's route and focus behaviour around the pages. A 700 ms loader shows no pending state while the rail already marks the next page (shell-1.10). A missing record and an unknown path both draw 'This address does not match any page' with no way back, and the unknown path keeps the nearest page's breadcrumb and title (shell-1.11). Closing the aside and a page action that navigates drop focus to `<body>` (shell-1.12). A phone `SplitPage` detail has no way back but the browser's (shell-1.13). The breadcrumb is a leaf only (shell-1.15); Escape does not close the docked aside (shell-1.16); a page store whose param collides with a global store throws at import and blanks every route (shell-1.17); the `routerDefaults` example names screens no subpath exports (shell-1.18). Evidence: `.evidence/cycle-shell-1/{actions,keyboard}.log`.
what: Route states, focus and the phone way back behave as one shell.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/shell/app-shell.tsx and the shell's breadcrumb, title and focus parts it uses
change: A navigation that waits past `defaultPendingMs` shows a pending state in main, and the rail's active item and the breadcrumb change together. The not-found screen takes a message and a link from `notFound({ data })`, defaults to a link home, and an unknown path's breadcrumb and title read 'Not found'. Closing the aside returns focus to the element that opened it, else main; a page-bar action that navigates leaves focus on main. Below the `wide` tier `SplitPage` draws a back link to its list above the detail. The crumb trail is decided and documented in `app-shell.md`. Escape in the docked aside closes it. The store collision error names the fix and is raised when the page store mounts. The `routerDefaults` example matches what ships. One layout or router test per change.
commits: fix: one commit per concern in packages/basalt-ui.
proof: make check; the tests named in the change.
acceptance: A slow loader shows a pending state in main after `defaultPendingMs`, and the rail and the breadcrumb change together (layout test)
`notFound()` from a page's loader draws a link back; an unknown path's title reads 'Not found' (router test)
Closing the docked aside with the keyboard leaves focus on the row that opened it (layout test)
At 390 px a `SplitPage` detail shows a back link to its list (layout test)
out_of_scope: Try again (v3-shell-1-route-retry); the phone sheet's state (v3-shell-1-phone-aside); the phone header (v3-shell-1-visual).
